item.title: Total War: Rome II CPU Performance Fix Mod Boosts FPS By 20%, Improves 0.1% Lows By 33%
item.description: More than 13 years after its release, Total War: Rome II has received a new community-developed CPU performance fix that delivers substantially higher frame rates and smoother gameplay, particularly during large-scale battles. Created by modder JGdaCaesar, the Rome 2 CPU Performance Fix addresses several CPU bottlenecks in Creative Assembly's aging Warscape engine, delivering up to 20% higher average FPS and 33% better 0.1% lows, according to the developer's benchmarks. Interestingly, this is the same modder behind the Total War: Attila CPU Performance Fix, which delivered massive performance improvements by addressing a severe multithreading bottleneck.
